issue.title: Bug: Helper function `generate_ip_through_default_route` causes test failures when using ipv6 address

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Low

### Description of the bug

Helper function `generate_ip_through_default_route` in `tests/common/helpers/generators.py` causes failures when passed an ipv6 ip address, as with the change https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-frr/commit/8c6489bc568a8a1714411cdb5b5a3c517bef941a / https://github.com/FRRouting/frr/pull/17898, `show ip addr <ipv6_addr>` returns `% Cannot specify IPv6 address/prefix for IPv4 table`

### Steps to Reproduce

The way we discovered and reproduce the bug is by running `tests/bgp/test_bgpmon_v6.py`.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

It should use `show ipv6 route` instead of `show ip route` when an ipv6 ip address is provided.
